description: Prospect site built on spec for Mécanique Jean-Maurice (14173, boul. du Curé-Labelle, Mirabel QC J7J 1M3). Sources: Liasse research dossier (Google panel 4.5★/26, contact, mailing address) and the garage's own 411garage.com listing (12 services, 7-day hours, 9 payment methods, email, emblem logo). Logo = their own listing emblem (permission to confirm at claim); all other imagery = studio illustrations in the emblem style.

designManifest.summary: Everything comes from the garage's own badge: charcoal plates with cream condensed capitals, the orange speed stripes over each title, hex-nut markers; booking and account are a cream shop ticket filled in orange-brown.
designManifest.signatureMove: A stamped OUVERT / FERMÉ plate in the header computed from the real 7-day hours (the emblem's orange banner when open).
